sandboxAttempt.environment: Windows 11 Enterprise 22621; Windows PowerShell 5.1; no Python/py/uv; network disabled
sandboxAttempt.failure: MCP tools/list returned JSON-RPC -32700 Parse error and installation rolled back.
sandboxAttempt.rootCause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 Process.StandardInput StreamWriter did not guarantee no-BOM UTF-8 bytes. The MCP server correctly retained strict raw_line.decode('utf-8') and json.loads parsing.

fix.processStartInfo: Set StandardInputEncoding to UTF8Encoding(false) when the runtime exposes that property.
fix.allRuntimes: Encode the complete JSON-RPC line with UTF8Encoding(false) and write bytes directly to StandardInput.BaseStream.
